plugins.name: Space Trader
plugins.description: The Palm OS classic, played in the chat window, from a panel with the ship's bars, a star chart you press to jump, and the market behind a button. Trade between 140 star systems, watch the prices move with tech level, government and whatever crisis a planet is living through, and fight off the pirates who stop you on the way — a round at a time, with the range, the odds and the shields all on screen. You make every move; the model reads the position each turn and advises, and never spends your credits or fires your guns itself.
plugins.author: alexbeatnik
